sections.title: Executive summary
sections.text: Insufficient evidence for a reliable diagnosis. Review the recorded observations and investigation limitations.

sections.title: Observed evidence
sections.text:
Campaign performance versus baseline and peers: 5 campaign(s) analysed over 90 h ending 2026-10-08T00:00:00.000Z: CTR 0.42%, spend £1807.65, 15 attributed orders, CPA £120.51, ROAS 0.92. Versus baseline: CTR -78.2%, hourly spend +10.9%, hourly attributed orders -81.2%. Observations are simulated ad-platform records; frequency and CTR describe exposure and response, not intent.

Revenue, orders and conversion versus baseline: Over 90 h ending 2026-10-08T00:00:00.000Z: 72 orders, net revenue £8004.26, 2721 sessions, conversion 2.65%. Baseline (78 h): hourly revenue -43.3% change, hourly orders -44.3%, hourly sessions -43.5%. Decomposition: sessions share 1.006, conversion share 0.025, AOV share -0.031 of the revenue change. Values are simulated business records; this describes what changed, not why.

Sessions, conversion and checkout failures: 2721 sessions and 72 orders over 90 h ending 2026-10-08T00:00:00.000Z (conversion 2.65%); 0 checkout failures (0.00% of sessions). Baseline: conversion 2.68% (-1.4% change), failures per hour n/a change, sessions per hour -43.5% change. Simulated storefront records; device and channel slices join orders to their canonical session.

Review volume, low ratings and delivery complaints: 25 reviews over 90 h ending 2026-10-08T00:00:00.000Z: 0 rated ≤2 (0.0%), average rating 4.32, 8 mention delivery terms. Most low-rated products: Nike Sportswear Tech Essentials (0/4), Nike Air Force 1 '07 (0/3), Nike Mercurial Superfly 11 Academy (0/3). Simulated review records; delivery mentions are a keyword heuristic.

Inventory levels, depletion and demand velocity: 17 product(s) observed to 2026-10-08T00:00:00.000Z: 0 at zero available units, 0 projected to run out within 72 h at current velocity, 57 units depleted in the 90 h window, 0 out-of-stock checkout failures. No product is currently out of stock. Simulated inventory records derived from canonical inventory.level_changed events.
